name: icefall-shared
description: Canonical domain model shared by every ICEFALL app: the money model and the company record. Edit HERE, then run `npm run sync`. Never hand-edit a generated src/money/model.ts or src/domain/companies.ts — they are copies.

scripts.test: npx tsx money.test.ts && npx tsx companies.test.ts
scripts.sync: for a in icefall-app icefall-web icefall-guide icefall-admin icefall-crm icefall-operator; do if [ -d ../$a ]; then mkdir -p ../$a/src/money ../$a/src/domain && cp money.ts ../$a/src/money/model.ts && cp companies.ts ../$a/src/domain/companies.ts && echo "  synced -> $a"; fi; done && echo 'money model + company record synced to every app'
